boundary_summary: Core changes implement generic L6 observability, future-run proposal contracts, and UWG-only writeback guardrails. App-specific runtime meaning remains under apps_rg and apps_eval. Post-merge Guardian namespace repair only updates generic dispatch metadata to maintained Guardian runner modules. SSOT discovery compatibility repair restores a generic file-discovery helper used by Guardian architecture governance. Scanner signal compatibility repair restores a generic class-level vocabulary consumed by Guardian architecture governance. Path-constants compatibility repair restores generic structure-blueprint L0 exports, and Guardian result-writer compatibility centralizes generic signing/correlation serialization.
